video_title: 2026 Mahindra XUV 7XO review - Sharper look, more tech, new suspension | First Drive | Autocar India

features.name: After Sales Service
verbatim: Mahindra’s issue is the inability to match the demand. They don’t know how to treat customers in the showroom. Overcrowded services Center.

features.name: Brand Value
verbatim: They just killed the legend XUV 700 by introducing this ! But legends never die

features.name: Build Quality
verbatim: How can you like the interiors? Looks after market straight from Karol Bagh.
Still a fiber tail? was expecting a steel+powered tailgate
But in terms of build and reliability they can't beat Mahindra thats why be it XUV 300 or 400 or 700 people will keep choosing them
suspension noise is now a lot less and that means you have a quieter cabin

features.name: Cabin Comfort
verbatim: Indeed middle row they could have kept a sliding option, so back row we can adjust with adults to pick them for functions or events
Hope this ventilated seats doesn't disappoint
both these seats are ventilated too
How much seater this car is this 5seater or 7seater ?

features.name: Climate Control
verbatim: The AC vent clips are pure BS in XUV700. I still didn’t complete 2 years but I had to get them changed twice coz they break easily and that is not expected from a 30 lakh car.
Vents in the center with a wireless charger lowdown that also has cooling so your phone doesn't heat up unnecessarily

features.name: Convenience Features
verbatim: XUV had everything...
it's a powerful car, it rides well now as well and it has a good amount of features.
I love the latest technology of manually operated boot! Worth the value!
the passenger screen unlike the one seen on the 9s gets a privacy skin that does not allow the driver to get distracted while driving
you get a phone tray and a wireless phone charger along with a 65 watt type C charger and a USB-A port as well for some of the older phones

features.name: Engine Options
verbatim: the diesel is not too far behind. The 2.2-litre, 186hp diesel gets 450nm of torque and torque is what highways love and on the highway, this car is just brilliant.
it just gets extra points just because it is available as a diesel. In an era where people are moving away from that fuel, Mahindra continues to power its flagship SUV with diesel.
No matter the budget, you're gonna have a variant for you, that's a very good touch.

features.name: Engine Performance
verbatim: Are there drive modes in the petrol version?
refinement is not as good as the petrol, but vibrations are nil, negligible. Nothing on the steering, nothing in the seats, there's none of that constant drone.
Performance is great, efficiency obviously is better and the Highways are still diesel territory.
